channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Michelle sugere que eleitores sejam mesários e fiscais do PL
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro urged supporters to become poll workers and monitors for the PL in the 2026 elections, stressing the need for greater female participation in electoral oversight. The 'Operation V2 – Watch and Vote' campaign launched with national radio and TV ads until June 20 and will continue on social media until July 20. She emphasized that the initiative increases transparency, enables vote monitoring, and provides legal benefits, encouraging women to register with the TRE or volunteer for the party.

item.title: A pesquisa eleitoral suspensa por Nunes Marques a pedido de Flávio - O Assunto #1.736
item.description: TSE Minister Nunes Marques monocratically suspended an Atlas Intel poll showing declining support for Flávio Bolsonaro after revelations that he solicited funds from Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse'. The ruling cited alleged 'methodological contamination' due to questions about the Banco Master scandal, despite Atlas Intel stating the questions were added post-electoral questionnaire and did not affect results. The TSE plenary began voting to uphold or overturn the injunction, as experts debate the unprecedented nature of the decision and the role of polls in informing voters.

item.title: Boulos explica em vídeo como será a rede “Porta-Vozes do Lula”
item.description: Minister Guilherme Boulos (Psol-SP) explained the functioning of the 'Porta-Vozes do Lula' platform, created by the PT to coordinate the activity of militants and influencers on social media during the pre-campaign for Lula's re-election. The initiative aims to counter the right's superiority in digital narrative organization by providing daily posting topics via WhatsApp, seeking to build discursive unity among supporters and prevent the left from remaining on the defensive.

item.title: Em meio à nova ameaça tarifária de Trump, Lula participa de reunião com empresários nesta quarta
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva attends the meeting of the Council for Sustainable Economic and Social Development (Conselhão) amid new U.S. tariff threats targeting Brazilian goods, with proposed rates up to 37,5%. The 10 a.m. session at Itamaraty will focus on national sovereignty, multilateralism, and international agenda, including presentations of the council’s work and a guide on combating femicide. In the afternoon, Vice President Geraldo Alckmin will lead a panel on economic, social, and sustainable development pathways.

item.title: OESTE SEM FILTRO - FLÁVIO CONSOLIDA VITÓRIA SOBRE LULA NO SEGUNDO TURNO - 09/06/2026
item.description: Flávio consolidates victory over Lula in the second round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election, according to Oeste Sem Filtro. The result marks a significant political shift, with the right-wing candidate defeating the incumbent president. The race reflects intense polarization around issues such as the economy, security, and governance.

item.title: PEC que dá autonomia financeira ao BC deve ser votada na CCJ do Senado nesta quarta; texto inclui PIX na Constituição
item.description: The PEC granting financial autonomy to the Central Bank will be voted on in the Senate's CCJ this Wednesday, despite disagreement between rapporteur Senator Plínio Valério and the Lula government over the institution's legal nature. Valério rejects the government's proposal to classify the BC as a 'special nature autarchy', arguing it would subordinate the bank to the Ministry of Management. The text also enshrines PIX in the Constitution, guaranteeing its free use for individuals and prohibiting its privatization or transfer of management to any entity outside the BC.

item.title: Com menções a Flávio e Vorcaro, PT lança estratégia digital para Lula
item.description: The PT launched the 'Porta-Vozes de Lula e do Brasil' platform to digitally mobilize supporters, in response to the backlash from the hashtag 'Tariflávio' targeting Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The party aims to strengthen its social media presence, advocating for greater dissemination of the R$134 million loan request by Daniel Vorcaro for the 'Dark Horse' film about Jair Bolsonaro to reveal the 'truth'. Deputies Erika Hilton and Guilherme Boulos stressed the need to counter right-wing narratives, threats to democracy, and the left's current digital disorganization compared to the opposition's effectiveness.

item.title: PL deve focar fundo eleitoral em Flávio e Senado, e deputados temem falta de recursos
item.description: The PL plans to focus its electoral fund of R$ 881.6 million on the campaigns of Flávio Bolsonaro for president and senatorial candidates, raising concerns among federal deputies about insufficient resources for their own bids. Party leadership fears that prioritizing majoritarian candidacies will leave legislators without adequate funding to compete in the 2026 elections.

item.title: PT lança iniciativa para reunir 'porta-vozes' de Lula nas redes sociais e confrontar bolsonarismo
item.description: The PT launched an initiative to form a group of 'spokespersons' on social media to boost President Lula's re-election campaign and confront bolsonarism. The effort aims to coordinate favorable messaging and counter opposition narratives, particularly around Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 presidential bid.

item.title: Plenário do TSE vai decidir se mantém suspensão de pesquisa eleitoral relativa ao cargo de presidente da República
item.description: The TSE plenary resumed judgment on the injunction suspending the release of the AtlasIntel electoral poll related to the 2026 presidential election. Minister Kassio Nunes Marques voted to maintain the suspension, but the proceedings were halted by a request for view from Minister Estela Aranha. The action was filed by the PL’s National Directory, claiming the questionnaire was designed to elicit responses detrimental to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: TSE confirma multa por propaganda eleitoral com informações falsas nas Eleições 2024 em Juriti (PA)
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) upheld a fine of R$ 5,000 against Giorge Figueira Souza for spreading electoral propaganda containing false information against Henrique Costa, a mayoral candidate in Juruti (PA) during the 2024 municipal elections. The false claims included allegations of Costa’s ineligibility and his alleged plan to abolish a social assistance program if elected. The ruling was unanimous, with Minister Estela Aranha as rapporteur, emphasizing the legal prohibition against disseminating known falsehoods that undermine electoral integrity.

item.title: TSE aprova nova política para reforçar proteção dos sistemas da Justiça Eleitoral contra ataques cibernéticos
item.description: The TSE Plenary unanimously approved the new Information Security Policy (PSI) of the Electoral Justice, aiming to strengthen protection of electoral systems against cyberattacks in the 2024 elections. The measure unifies cybersecurity rules, enhances prevention and incident response, and establishes permanent governance structures, taking effect immediately after publication, with full compliance required by December 31, 2027.

item.title: Michelle diz que ajudará campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro no 'momento certo'
item.description: Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) stated she hopes the house arrest of former President Jair Bolsonaro will be maintained after the 90-day period granted by Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, which ends this month. She also said she will support Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign at the 'right moment'.

item.title: Michelle põe candidatura em xeque e diz que apoiará Flávio Bolsonaro no momento certo; veja vídeo
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro said she will request an extension of Jair Bolsonaro’s humanitarian house arrest, which ends this month, and that she will not run for Senate in 2026 while caring for him. She added that, at the right time, she will support the presidential campaign of her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, emphasizing that her current priority is her husband’s health.

item.title: Durigan elogia Alcolumbre após reunião sobre pautas-bomba: ‘confio na condução’
item.description: Finance Minister Dário Durigan praised Senate President Davi Alcolumbre after a meeting aimed at slowing the advance of economically sensitive proposals known as 'budget bombs', which could impact public finances by up to 270 billion reais. Durigan said he trusts Alcolumbre’s leadership on these issues, citing the delicate global economic moment and risks to Brazil’s economy, despite the strained relationship between Alcolumbre and President Lula. The meeting took place at the Senate’s official residence and also included José Guimarães, the government’s political articulation minister.

item.title: Nunes Marques alimenta tese conspiratória dos Bolsonaros e repete centralização de 2022
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques, presiding over the TSE, followed the interventionist line of Alexandre de Moraes by suspending the release of AtlasIntel poll data, citing suspicions of voter induction, despite lacking plenary approval. The move was embraced by Bolsonaro’s allies as validation of their conspiracy theory that polls are biased against them, fueling distrust and encouraging new legal challenges. The decision also raised concerns among other TSE ministers and Lula government officials, who fear the court is being weaponized, reviving the polarized judicial climate of 2022 with reversed ideological narratives.

item.title: TSE suspende julgamento sobre pesquisa que apontou queda de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: TSE Minister Nunes Marques granted Flávio Bolsonaro’s request to suspend an AtlasIntel poll showing a seven-point drop in his voter intentions against Lula. Minister Estela Aranha requested a view, halting the judgment for up to 30 days under TSE internal rules. The poll was criticized for embedding audio of Bolsonaro’s conversation with former Master Bank CEO Daniel Vorcaro after asking respondents if they knew about the scandal, which the minister argued introduced negative stimuli and undermined the poll’s neutrality.

item.title: Estela Aranha interrompe julgamento de suspensão de pesquisa sobre Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro
item.description: TSE Minister Estela Aranha interrupted the judgment of the injunction that suspended the AtlasIntel poll on Flávio Bolsonaro, keeping the suspension pending further review. The poll linked the PL pre-candidate to Banco Master and Daniel Vorcaro after an audio surfaced where he requested R$134 million for a film about Jair Bolsonaro. Ministers including Kassio Nunes Marques and Dias Toffoli emphasized the debate concerns future parameters for electoral polls in 2026, not the specific content already published.

item.title: TSE suspende julgamento sobre liminar que derrubou pesquisa AtlasIntel sobre Flávio
item.description: The TSE suspended the ruling on an injunction blocking the release of an AtlasIntel poll showing a six-point drop in voting intention for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, following a request for review by Minister Estela Aranha. The decision responded to a challenge by the Liberal Party, which disputed the poll's methodology, and sparked debate among justices about establishing stricter standards for future electoral surveys.

item.title: TSE adia decisão sobre suspensão de pesquisa de voto para presidente
item.description: The TSE postponed its ruling on the validity of an AtlasIntel poll showing a drop in voting intention for Flávio Bolsonaro, after Minister Estela Aranha requested a view. The current vote stands at 1-0 in favor of suspending the poll, with TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques having already voted to suspend it over concerns of methodological bias tied to the Master case and an audio clip of Flávio seeking funds for the Dark Horse film. Kassio’s individual decision already bars the poll’s publication, republication, or boosting on social media and official channels.

item.title: TSE adia decisão sobre pesquisa AtlasIntel que indicou queda de Flávio
item.description: TSE Minister Nunes Marques provisionally suspended the release of an AtlasIntel poll showing declining voter intentions for Flávio Bolsonaro, accepting PL's argument that the survey contained eight leading questions tied to the Banco Master scandal and based on unverified audio. Minister Estela Aranha requested a view, delaying the full court's decision on whether to uphold the injunction. AtlasIntel defended the poll, expressing confidence in the TSE's technical review.

item.title: STF marca retomada de julgamento sobre anistia a partidos que descumpriram cotas
item.description: The STF has scheduled the resumption of judgment on the amnesty for parties that failed to meet resource quotas for Black, mixed-race and female candidates. Despite a request for view by Minister Alexandre de Moraes, the Court already formed a majority to uphold the 2024 Constitutional Amendment, with votes in favor from Zanin, Toffoli, Mendonça, Marques, Fux and Mendes. The dissent comes from Flávio Dino, supported by Cármen Lúcia and Edson Fachin, who argues the amnesty constitutes a prohibited social setback under the Constitution.

item.title: Ministro do TSE diz que 2022 é “atestado de confiabilidade” das urnas
item.description: TSE Minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques stated that the electronic voting machines from the 2022 elections underwent rigorous testing and investigations, with no irregularities found, serving as an 'attestation of seriousness and reliability'. He noted that questioning the vote count is not illicit, but the 2022 investigation requests were deemed bad-faith litigation, and that claims of urn unreliability are becoming discredited ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Ministra do TSE pede vista e adia julgamento sobre pesquisa da AtlasIntel
item.description: Minister Estella Aranha of the TSE requested a view and postponed the ruling on the validity of the AtlasIntel poll showing declining popularity for Flávio Bolsonaro, following an audio linking him to Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro. Relator Minister Kássio Nunes Marques voted to invalidate the poll, claiming it attempted to influence respondents by associating the senator with financial fraud, constituting political bias and overstepping polling boundaries. The suspension of the poll on official websites remains pending Aranha’s forthcoming vote.

item.title: TSE adia julgamento sobre suspensão de pesquisa que apontou queda de Flávio após áudio com Vorcaro
item.description: The TSE postponed the ruling on the injunction that suspended the AtlasIntel poll showing a six-point drop in Flávio Bolsonaro’s voting intention against Lula, after Minister Estela Aranha requested a view of the case. TSE President Kássio Nunes Marques reiterated there are indications of leading questions in the poll and defended banning further disclosure of details until a final decision. Ministers such as Dias Toffoli and André Mendonça emphasized the case’s importance in setting boundaries for inducement in electoral polls, without preempting their votes.

item.title: TSE mantém suspensão de pesquisa com áudio contra Flávio, mas adia decisão
item.description: Justice Nunes Marques of the TSE voted to maintain the suspension of the AtlasIntel poll conducted after the release of audio involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former banker Daniel Vorcaro. However, Justice Estela Aranha requested more time for analysis, postponing the final decision.

item.title: Toffoli toma posse no TSE e diz que Justiça não decide eleição
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli was sworn in as an effective minister of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) to fill the vacancy left by Carmen Lucía, stressing that justice does not decide elections, but the people do through their vote. He emphasized voter sovereignty and equality at the moment of casting the ballot in the electronic voting machine. The TSE’s new composition includes Kassio Nunes Marques as president, André Mendonça as vice-president, and other ministers from the STF, STJ, and presidential appointees.

item.title: Nunes Marques vota por manter pesquisa suspensa e ministra pede vista
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques voted to maintain the suspension of the AtlasIntel poll showing declining voting intentions for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after revelations of sponsorship of the film Dark Horse by banker Daniel Vorcaro. The judgment was interrupted when Minister Estela Aranha requested a view of the process. The poll had been suspended due to potential economic power abuse and undue influence in the campaign.

item.title: Toffoli assume vaga como ministro do TSE
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli assumed a seat on the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on June 9, 2026, returning after 14 years, replacing Cármen Lúcia. The swearing-in ceremony took place during a TSE session with STF justices and the electoral prosecutor general present, highlighting his pioneering role in implementing Brazil’s electoral biometric system. The TSE is now fully constituted for the 2026 general elections.

item.title: Pedido de vista interrompe julgamento no TSE sobre decisão de Nunes Marques que suspendeu pesquisa após pedido de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The TSE's judgment on President Kássio Nunes Marques' decision to suspend an AtlasIntel poll on Flávio Bolsonaro was halted after a request for vista by Minister Estela Aranha, leaving the injunction blocking the poll's publication in place. The suspension was based on concerns that the questionnaire influenced responses by referencing an audio of the senator discussing funding for the film 'Dark Horse'. AtlasIntel denies inducement and claims other institutes found similar electoral impact patterns.

item.title: Com campanha sob pressão após caso 'Dark Horse', Flávio Bolsonaro endurece tom na segurança e defende castração química
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro intensified his public security rhetoric following the 'Dark Horse' scandal, advocating for lowering the age of criminal responsibility, chemical castration for sex offenders, and designating PCC and CV as terrorist organizations by the U.S. He also criticized the federal government's stance on agribusiness and pledged stronger support for rural producers under a future Bolsonaro-led administration.

item.title: Governo vai defender que deputados da base votem contra a redução da maioridade penal para 16 anos
item.description: The Lula government will direct ruling coalition deputies to vote against the PEC lowering the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16, aiming to avoid appearing lenient on crime during an election year. Although the PT historically opposes the measure, Justice Minister Wellington César Lima e Silva advocates for a reexamination, noting varying maturity levels and Parliament’s right to debate. The proposal, backed by rapporteur Coronel Assis (PL-MT), will be voted on in the CCJ this Tuesday.

item.title: PEC do fim da 6 X 1 deve ir à CCJ na próxima semana, diz Randolfe
item.description: Senator Randolfe Rodrigues (PT-AP) announced that the PEC to end the 6x1 work scale will be sent to the Senate's CCJ next week for expedited voting in a single committee. He said there is favorable support to reduce the 14-month transition period, arguing workers have waited 150 years for this change. He dismissed compensatory measures like payroll tax exemptions and opposed the opposition's Flexible Work Hours PEC, calling it a 'reestablishment of slave labor'.

item.title: Por que Lula não vai à missa? Janja rebate Malafaia e PT lança carta para evangélicos
item.description: First Lady Janja explained during the 4th National Meeting of Evangelicals of the PT why President Lula avoids attending public masses, citing security concerns and respect for presidential protocols. She also rebutted recent criticisms from Pastor Silas Malafaia, defending the government's stance toward the evangelical community. The PT launched a manifesto aimed at Christian voters to broaden its support within this demographic.

item.title: Dias Toffoli assume cargo de ministro efetivo no TSE
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli officially assumed the position of effective minister at the TSE, replacing Cármen Lúcia, and reaffirmed his commitment to voter sovereignty in the October elections. He emphasized that the people, not the judiciary, decide the electoral process. The TSE’s new composition now features Kassio Nunes Marques as president, André Mendonça as vice-president, and Toffoli as an effective minister.

item.title: Pedido de vista adia análise do TSE de decisão que suspendeu pesquisa que mostrou queda de intenção de votos de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The TSE suspended the judgment on the individual decision by Minister Kassio Nunes Marques that ordered the removal of an AtlasIntel poll showing a five-point drop in Flávio Bolsonaro's voting intentions. Minister Estela Aranha's request for a vista halted the analysis, keeping the poll's suspension in effect until further review. The case sparked debate among ministers regarding its electoral impact and the need for dialogue with polling institutes.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro faz campanha em reduto do pai na Bahia e critica governo Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) visited Luís Eduardo Magalhães in Bahia during the Bahia Farm Show to strengthen his electoral base in one of the last Bolsonarist strongholds in the state. He praised rural producers' support, criticized the Lula government for treating agribusiness as 'fascist' and 'criminal', and pledged to combat narcoterrorism, aligning with the U.S. designation of PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations.

item.title: Senado aprova proteção a trabalhadores resgatados de trabalho escravo
item.description: The Senate approved bill PL 5760/2023, which establishes protections for workers rescued from conditions analogous to slavery, including access to unemployment insurance, inclusion in the CadÚnico social registry, amendments to the Maria da Penha Law for emergency shelter, and authorization for labor auditors to enter residences without a court order when exploitation is suspected. The bill also provides urgent protective measures for domestic workers, particularly women, and awaits presidential sanction.

item.title: Toffoli toma posse como ministro efetivo do TSE
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli was sworn in as an effective member of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on Tuesday, the 9th, filling the vacancy left by former Court president Minister Cármen Lúcia. His appointment is strategically timed to allow the new TSE president, Kassio Nunes Marques, more time to lead the court before and during the 2026 elections.

item.title: Líder do governo quer tramitação rápida da PEC 6×1 e pede efeito imediato
item.description: Government leader in Congress Randolfe Rodrigues (PT-AP) advocates for rapid processing of the PEC to end the 6×1 work schedule, proposing an immediate reduction to a 40-hour workweek without a lengthy transition period. He highlights a favorable climate in the Senate for swift approval, citing sympathy from Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) and the urgency of a measure debated since 1988. It remains unclear whether the PEC will proceed solely through the Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) or require a special committee, although Senate rules do not provide for the latter for this type of proposal.

item.title: Câmara aprova regime de urgência para 18 projetos
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved urgency regime for 18 bills, allowing direct voting in the Plenary without prior committee review. The proposals include measures on cybercrime penalties, women's integral health policy, national laboratory diagnostics in SUS, protection against gender-based political violence, public sector labor relations, extension of tax benefits for merchant navy, infrastructure financing in Northern, Northeastern and Central-Western regions, indigenous adaptation protocol in risk situations, and credit expansion for Brazilian exporters.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro pede visita de nora e netas no dia em que Brasil estreia na Copa do Mundo
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense requested STF permission for his daughter-in-law and two minor granddaughters to visit him on June 13, the date of Brazil's 2026 World Cup opener. Bolsonaro has been under house arrest since March following bacterial pneumonia and was sentenced in September 2025 to 27 years and 3 months for his role in a coup attempt. The request was submitted to Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Governo se reúne com Alcolumbre para tentar barrar ‘pautas-bomba’
item.description: The Lula government met with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to block so-called 'bombshell' bills feared by the economic team, including rural debt renegotiation (R$120B), full pension parity for health agents, a new minimum wage for doctors and dentists (R$47B), and an increase in municipal fund transfers (R$10B in 2026). The meeting took place amid strained relations between Lula and Alcolumbre following the rejection of Jorge Messias’ STF nomination, with Durigan and Guimarães acting as political intermediaries.

item.title: Dino multa Estados e municípios por falta de transparência em emendas
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered daily fines of 1% on received Pix amendment funds for states and municipalities failing to ensure transparency and traceability, including submission of Work Plans and management reports via Transferegov.br. The MGI has 10 days to identify irregularities and notify non-compliant entities, while the CGU has 5 business days to present an audit schedule for amendments from 2020 to 2024. Fines collected will fund audits by MGI and CGU, particularly targeting opaque allocations to the events sector.

item.title: PT lança 'Porta-Vozes do Lula', iniciativa com missões e ranking digital de apoiadores
item.description: The PT launched 'Porta-Vozes do Lula,' an initiative to organize digital militants in defense of the government and coordinate actions against opponents. The program includes missions and a digital ranking to engage supporters of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: TSE julga decisão de Nunes Marques que suspendeu pesquisa com queda de Flávio
item.description: The TSE ruled on Minister Nunes Marques' decision to suspend the publication of an electoral poll showing a decline in Flávio Bolsonaro, granting a request from the PL party, which claimed the poll induced negative voter responses. The Court president ordered the institute to remove the data, stating the issue does not concern freedom of expression but compliance with specific electoral poll regulations.

item.title: PT lança ‘Porta-Vozes do Lula’, iniciativa com missões e ranking digital de apoiadores do presidente
item.description: The PT launched 'Porta-Vozes do Lula', an initiative to organize digital militants in defense of the government, combat misinformation, and mobilize supporters through daily missions and a points-based ranking. The project includes members from the PT, PCdoB, PSOL, PSB, and other allied parties, using WhatsApp groups and social media content to spread messages. The first mission is to recruit new participants, with points awarded for referrals.

item.title: Lula vai explorar ‘ligações perigosas’ entre Flávio e Vorcaro com time de influenciadores digitais
item.description: Lula's campaign plans to use digital influencers and groups called 'Lula's Spokespersons' to spread positive content about his government and attack Flávio Bolsonaro, leveraging the World Cup period. The strategy involves holding back robust allegations about dangerous links between Flávio and Daniel Vorcaro — including a purported video and financial negotiations for the film 'Dark Horse' — for the final days of the campaign, while audio recordings and spreadsheets already link funds to expenses for Bolsonaro's relatives.

item.title: Ao vivo: TSE analisa veto de Nunes Marques a pesquisa da AtlasIntel
item.description: The TSE is reviewing whether an AtlasIntel poll violated electoral law by linking voter intention to conversations about money requests for a film about former President Bolsonaro. Minister Kássio Nunes Marques ordered the suspension of the poll’s dissemination and demanded methodological explanation within 2 days, responding to a request from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The preliminary ruling affects the poll registered as BR-06939/2026, released on May 19.

item.title: STF retoma julgamento sobre perdão a partidos por descumprimento de cotas raciais
item.description: The STF resumes judgment on the constitutionality of EC 133, which pardons parties for failing to meet racial quotas in electoral funding. The 2024 amendment reduced mandatory funding for Black and brown candidates and created a party debt refinancing program. With 6 votes in favor of upholding the law and 3 against, the case returns to the virtual docket from June 19–26 after Justice Alexandre de Moraes returned the case files.
